profile.name: Muhammad Rizky Pangestu
profile.intro: I build dependable backend systems, from API design and integrations to the services that keep products running.

I enjoy the less visible side of software: making services predictable, maintaining clear boundaries, and helping teams ship features that are reliable beyond the first release.
